data.desc: Camden Property Trust , an S&P 500 Company, is a real estate company primarily engaged in the ownership, management, development, redevelopment, acquisition, and construction of multifamily apartment communities. Camden owns and operates 168 properties containing 56,995 apartment homes across the United States . Upon completion of 4 properties currently under development, the Company's portfolio will increase to 58,555 apartment homes in 172 properties. Camden has been recognized as one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by FORTUNE magazine for 19 consecutive years, most recently ranking #13.
